_rule: A library entry is a promise: what it does, how to call it, what it needs. If an entry cannot be called from another module without reading that module's source, it does not belong here yet.

services.title: The DAG as bullets
services.use_when: An agent or a pane needs the shared human state without shipping the 62 KB store.

services.title: N bite-size pages for a non-reader
services.cost: one GET per minute; three upstream calls
services.use_when: Something must be noticed by a person walking past. Composes, never executes: a button is a declaration.

services.title: Registered maintenance with receipts
services.cost: one beat per 10 min; ifChanged makes repeat runs cost a hash
services.use_when: Upkeep is due: docs drift, dead leases, digest checks, session debt. Never starts AI work.

services.title: Two-tier scoring for a small model
services.returns: agentic-eval.json: per-task objective points, raw answers, judge score + why
services.cost: 5 calls per candidate, one judge call per task
services.use_when: Choosing a model for a node, or proving a change did not make an agent worse.

services.title: Salvage a drive without lying to yourself
services.call: enumerate disks -> size folders -> copy -> verify path-by-path -> SOURCE.txt -> only then wipe
services.returns: E:\SALVAGE\<model>-<date>\ with SOURCE.txt and verified counts
services.cost: hours for hundreds of GB; the verify pass costs one extra walk
services.use_when: Any pulled disk. The rule that matters: same file count AND same bytes on both sides, mismatch zero.

services.title: One key, every node
services.returns: standard chat completions; rotates pooled provider keys
services.cost: one hop; no key distribution to nodes
services.use_when: A node needs a big model without holding credentials.
